body: @DaveCTurner I think this is a bug in `MockTransportService`. We're removing the channels from the `openConnections` map in close listeners. If we're not doing a blocking close when calling `super.doClose()`, then there's a chance those don't finish before we assert that the map is empty. I'll see if I can find a fix :)

> If we're not doing a blocking close when calling super.doClose(), then there's a chance those don't finish before we assert that the map is empty. I'll see if I can find a fix :)

The blocking listener is not guaranteed to be called after the listener that removes the connection. So it might be a race in the order of listeners called. I don't know. But that is something to look at. A. possible fix (if that is the issue) is to do some type assert loop for a few seconds to wait for all connections to be removed.
